prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: whiplash. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1244; do not mention it.)
text:
Our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was lawfully traveling in the right-hand lane when your insured changed lanes without signaling or checking the blind spot, striking the driver's side of our client's vehicle and forcing it toward the shoulder. The police report documents the lane change and identifies your insured as the party who failed to yield the right of way.

As a direct result of the impact, our client suffered a whiplash injury to the neck and upper back. Following the collision, our client was evaluated at the emergency department and has since attended ongoing physical therapy and chiropractic care. Our client continues to experience neck stiffness, headaches, and restricted range of motion, and has missed time from work while recovering.

Liability in this matter is clear, and your insured's negligence is the proximate cause of our client's injuries and resulting losses. Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this incident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice and seek all available damages.
